question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the italicized word.

"Can I *borrow* your cell?" She asked.
solution:
The correct answer is '**lend**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The italicised word in the sentence, "**borrow**," refers to taking something from someone with the intention of returning it later (उधार लेना).

 
 
• **Example**: He needed to **borrow **a pen as he had forgotten his at home.
 
 
 
• The correct word, "**lend**," signifies giving something to someone for a short period, expecting it to be returned (उधार देना).
 
 
• **Example**: She decided to **lend **her calculator to her classmate for the exam.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bite **means to use the teeth to cut into something (काटना).

 
 
• **Example**: The apple was so fresh, he couldn't wait to **bite **into it.
 
 
 
• **Rent **refers to paying someone for the use of (an object, property, or service) (किराया पर लेना).
 
 
• **Example**: They decided to **rent **a car for their vacation.
 
 
 
• **Hire **means to obtain the temporary use of (something) for an agreed payment; it can also mean to employ someone (किराए पर लेना, नौकरी पर रखना).
 
 
• **Example**: She was going to **hire **a dress for the prom night.
